records.title: Bithomp — live account pages for five Binance-labelled XRPL source wallets and attacker receiver
records.note: Bithomp's attacker receiver page currently shows 233.5M XRP, approximately USD 289.5M at the page's displayed quote, and 'No transactions found' after activation at 2026-10-29 20:05 UTC by Binance-labelled rDAE53... with 185,017,485.5 XRP. The five Binance-labelled source accounts currently display approximate XRP balances: rDAE53... 11.59 XRP; rBtttd... 8.60 XRP; rfQ9... 8.60 XRP; rarG... 302.0K XRP; rNU4... 7,361 XRP. Their approximate combined residual is 309,389.79 XRP. Bithomp shows rDAE... later sent 11,141,435.843 XRP to Binance-labelled rs8Z... at 2026-10-29 23:12 UTC and 51,172,508 RLUSD to the same Binance-labelled destination at 2026-10-30 01:27 UTC. The destination account currently displays about 1.6B XRP. These later movements are internal between Bithomp-labelled Binance accounts; they are not proof that the stolen XRP was recovered. The account pages are dynamic explorer observations and their displayed balances can change.

records.title: XRP Insights — daily attributed exchange-wallet balances, October 29–30, 2026
records.note: The daily dataset uses rippled account_info on validated ledgers at approximately 08:00 UTC and XRPSCAN public labels for wallet attribution; it is not an estimate of tradable float. October 30 08:00 snapshot reports 22.37B XRP across 24 exchanges/701 wallets. Binance is 2.58B across 153 wallets, down 173.2M over seven days and 164.5M over 30 days; the October 29 page displayed about 2.80B, so the rounded day-to-day change is approximately -220M XRP. The Binance total includes approximately 327.4M non-customer Binance-Peg XRP backing and a separately counted Binance US balance. Coinbase is 5.84B across 358 wallets, including approximately 151.4M cbXRP backing; seven-day change +1.1M and 30-day +12.5M. Upbit is 6.43B; South Korean exchanges total 8.60B; Japanese exchanges 1.38B. SBI VC Trade is 59.5M across two wallets, more than 99% cold, down 893K over seven days and 10.5M over 30 days. The public JSON endpoint provides aggregate daily exchange totals and methodology, not per-wallet historical balances or a direct crosswalk of the five compromised accounts.
